test: zero-oracle, same witness-source states: q_generic(max_modules=8) vs the REPAIRED q_region_jump.  Run only after the jump lane binds.
engineering_target: coherent options of 12-18 primitives, capacity to ~20.  NOT 23.  Derived from the cap sweep: C<=8 stages only 2 of 11 routes, C=12 gives 6, C=16 gives 8, C=18-20 gives 9, and the remaining two are the known tiny-valley cases rather than evidence for larger actions.
current_regime: blind generator realizes a median program of ~4 primitives
DO_NOT_USE_AS_A_HARD_CRITERION: 'witness similarity reaches 0.4-0.7'.  That is an illustrative outcome, not a definition of success.  The witness is ONE valid route; a good region jump may produce a DIFFERENT useful structural transformation and would be scored as a failure by a similarity threshold.  Same rule as T4's support-restoration gate: never score a mechanism on reproducing one specific answer.
coherence_is_a_BUNDLE_measure_all_five: similarity to the witness macro endpoint
heavy-atom / ring / changed-region deltas against the REQUIRED macro (witness needs +13 heavy, +2 rings; generic delivers +5, +0 at both module budgets)
percentage of proposals landing in the useful 12-18 primitive band
exact or near-exact witness hits -- a strong BONUS, never the sole definition
what_counts_as_strong_evidence: sim_max_large moving from ~0.12 to 0.3+ WHILE also producing the correct region/ring scale and improving target progress.  Any one of those alone is weak.
do_not_touch_fibercontrol: The bottleneck is upstream of the controller: FiberControl cannot select a coherent macro the proposal process never exposes.  No controller work until coherent proposals exist.
